title: WHODUNIT: Evaluation benchmark for culprit detection in mystery stories

bias_targets.methodology: Substituting character names with Bollywood celebrity names versus Hollywood celebrity names to evaluate whether the model can apply the same deductive reasoning process across different cultural references.

Replacing original character names with those of well-known real (Hollywood/Bollywood) or fictional (Harry Potter) entities to assess the model's ability to disregard pre-trained associations and focus on narrative context.
